lines.text: Tesla just dropped the words "Full Self-Driving" in Europe.
Its European websites now call it "Tesla Assisted Driving".
So what does the new name really tell you? Let's bust two myths.
Myth number one: Full Self-Driving means the car drives itself.
Fact: it can steer, brake and accelerate, but the driver must watch the road and stays responsible.
Germany's transport ministry said the old name was misleading.
Myth number two: Europe has banned it.
Fact: the Netherlands approved it in April, and Germany now backs approval across the EU.
In the US, it's still called Full Self-Driving (Supervised).
Same tech, new name. Because words matter.
